_comment: Per environment (prompt drift strategy 14, ML-07). Dev is shared and noisy; pre-prod and prod are strict because pre-prod should match prod. Ratios compare a run with the same environment's own baseline, never with another environment's. quality_drop_max is a drop in a 0 to 1 quality mean. Change a value only with an evaluation report, and record it in CHANGES.md. The "logs" block is for logwatch.py: min_calls is how many calls a window needs before it is judged; the shares are of calls or pages in the window. prompt_worse_share_delta is how many percentage points more repaired or refused answers a new prompt version may have than the one before.
